title: Notice-to-Vacate Cleaning Discount on the Security Deposit Account
content:
**Rule.** Notice given before moving out earns a notice cleaning discount on the Security Deposit Account. The discount depends on when the written notice to vacate on the lease's completed last term, under the Lease Term Agreement, was received:

- **15.00 USD** when it was received at least 60 calendar days before the move-out date;
- **7.50 USD** when it was received at least 30, but fewer than 60, calendar days before it;
- **none** when it was received later, or when no notice is on file.

The discount is deducted from the corrected cleaning charge. The corrected cleaning charge is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Records read.** From the Lease Term Agreement: the date the written notice to vacate was received, on the lease's completed last term. From the deposit account: the move-out date. The days are the calendar days from the notice date to the move-out date.

## Ladder

| Calendar days from notice received to move-out | Discount |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 15.00 USD |
| 30 to 59 | 7.50 USD |
| 29 or fewer, or no notice on file | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, move-out 30 April)

| Notice received | Days before move-out | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 60 | 15.00 USD |
| 2 March | 59 | 7.50 USD |
| 31 March | 30 | 7.50 USD |
| 1 April | 29 | none |
| no notice on the completed last term | not applicable | none |
